core: A quadratic function in vertex form is $f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k$; its vertex is $(h, k)$.
If $a > 0$ the parabola opens upward, if $a < 0$ downward.
Completing the square turns $x^2 + bx$ into $\left(x + \tfrac{b}{2}\right)^2 - \left(\tfrac{b}{2}\right)^2$.
